text:
Mira Chen: Mini-golf + craft beers after work Friday? Found a place with a rooftop course and a taproom. Thinking 7pm. Anyone in? :golf: :beers: Shuttle from office at 6:20 if people want it.
Ravi Patel: count me in. shuttle pls, cheaper than Ubers :raised_hands:
Jean Ortega: I'm in too. can we do vegetarian snack options? also how many slots on shuttle?
Mira Chen: good q — shuttle is a 12-seat van. I can book 2 vans if demand >12. RSVP poll below, will finalize tomorrow. Link to sign-up: https://forms.gle/mini-golf-pickup (pls fill name + home neighborhood)
Alex Gomez: :raised_hands: doing it. if we need more seats I can drive 3 other people in my car.
Samira Khan: not sure yet, maybe late meeting. add me as maybe? :thinking_face:
Kat Lee: i'm down! any karaoke after? :microphone:
Mira Chen: ha maybe. the venue sometimes has a corner for it. poll: react with :thumbsup: = yes, :wave: = maybe, :thumbsdown: = no
ops-bot: Reminder: please follow conference-celebrations policy re: alcohol on company events. If driving, please don't drink and drive. :memo:
Jean Ortega: thanks ops-bot. I'm :thumbsup: on poll
Ravi Patel: :thumbsup:
Alex Gomez: :wave:
Samira Khan: :thumbsdown: later meeting — but want to join if meeting ends early, adding myself to the form as 'maybe'
Mira Chen: perfect. current headcount: 6 confirmed, 2 maybes. I'll book 1 van for 12 tonight at 11pm unless more signups. If you want to split cost, I'll put pickup cost on splitwise. Link: https://splitwise.com/mini-golf-ride
Mira Chen: final note: bring a jacket (rooftop gets breezy) and your ID for the taproom. See you Friday!
